method: Human-visible image inspection after native rendering, isolated edge-on KiCad-export views of VR4, VR5, S1 and S2, and a pixel comparison of every view with revision 17. Hashes pin the reviewed images.

comparison_with_revision_17.rear: identical within render noise (max channel difference 1)
comparison_with_revision_17.exploded: identical within render noise (max channel difference 18, no pixel above 24)
comparison_with_revision_17.control_side: 3,642 of 2,520,000 pixels differ by more than 24: the formed legs at the pot and switch bases and soft shadows
comparison_with_revision_17.io_terminals_detail: 15,300 of 1,350,000 pixels differ by more than 24: the SDS-50J and MJ-3536N legs

observations: Edge-on views from the native KiCad export show L-shaped terminals running from the Panasonic, NKK and CTS body edges into each pin; the Alpha legs join the wafer edge.
Every terminal on the terminal sheet now meets its body; drill rings are unchanged.
The assembled case, rear panel and legends are unchanged.
limitations: Leg heights and bends are assumptions; images do not qualify physical assembly fit.
